name: plan-checklist
description: Claude's plan as a checklist in a side pane, ticked off as it works.

require_plan_first.title: Require a plan first
require_plan_first.description: Refuse every other tool call until Claude has called plan_steps for the request. Off by default. The require_plan_first key in ~/.config/plan-checklist/config.json, when true or false, wins over this.
